syllabus.title: Practice Test-08 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Centre of Mass & System of Particles (Complete Chapter), Rotational Motion (Complete Chapter), Gravitation (Complete Chapter)

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Chemical Kinetics (Complete Chapter), Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties : Introduction, Need for Classification of Elements, Historical Development of Classification of Elements, Modern Periodic Law and Present Form of the Periodic Table, Merits of Long Form of Periodic Table Over Mendeleev's Periodic Table, Electronic Configuration of Elements and The Periodic Table

📌 BOTANY
• Morphology of Flowering Plants (Complete Chapter), Anatomy of Flowering Plants (Complete Chapter)

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Neural control and coordination (Complete Chapter)
